phase6_analysis._comment: Declared phase6 measurement thresholds, fixed-size comparison and L3w smoothing. No tuning after seed3003 results.

day_types._comment: Hidden daily category, independent of weather. Patrol plans yield to existing event/safety rules. No day_type in public context exports.

weather._comment: Daily observable category; ambient temperature is causal trailing-smoothed measurement. Rain/hot water effects apply to voluntary daytime and night choices; physical/event rules unchanged.

heading_features._comment: Analysis only: trailing observed displacement window; km threshold; bearing tolerance in degrees. Distance bins are fixed at 1.5 km.

l5_analysis._comment: Analysis only: L3 prior pseudo-count and deterministic split-local goal permutation seed. No tuning after results.

_comment: All simulator parameters. Keys beginning with an underscore document nearby settings and do not affect simulation. Distances are km unless named otherwise; rates are per hour.

_comments.day_start: Start time of each independent simulated day.
_comments.step_minutes: GPS and hidden-state cadence; currently must remain 1.
_comments.report_times: Ordered report clock times after the day start, including the final day boundary.

_comments.width_km: Map extent in x, with zero as minimum.
_comments.height_km: Map extent in y, with zero as minimum.
_comments.entry_hysteresis_minutes: Consecutive true-position samples required before a named zone entry.

Den._comment: Den circle: centre coordinates, radius in km, and plot color.

Kopje._comment: Kopje circle: centre coordinates, radius in km, and plot color.

Shade._comment: Shade circle: centre coordinates, radius in km, and plot color.

Waterhole._comment: Waterhole circle: centre coordinates, radius in km, and plot color.

Plain._comment: Open plain rectangle: inclusive x/y limits in km and plot color.

Hunting ground._comment: Hunting ground circle: centre coordinates, radius in km, and plot color.

Feeding spot._comment: Feeding spot circle: centre coordinates, radius in km, and plot color.

Road._comment: Tourist road rectangle: inclusive x/y limits in km and plot color.

randomness._phase6_comment: Temperature keeps the legacy learnability canonical alias. Once/day uniform jitter: midday start/end, hunt readiness, tourist start; legal hunt bounds unchanged.

_comments.wake_time_sd_minutes: Standard deviation of the daily normal wake time.
_comments.bar_noise_sd: Independent Gaussian bar perturbation per minute before clipping to [0,1].
_comments.score_noise_sd: Gaussian goal-logit noise at each goal choice.
_comments.gps_noise_sd_m: Independent x/y Gaussian GPS observation noise in metres.
_comments.gps_dropout_probability: Independent missing-fix probability; observed coordinates are forward-filled.

_comments.energy_awake_per_hour: Energy change while awake and stationary.
_comments.energy_walking_per_hour: Total energy change while moving, replacing stationary awake rate.
_comments.temperature_time_constant_hours: Relaxation time to the ambient target.
_comments.temperature_cooling_bonus: Target temperature change in a cooling zone.
_comments.boredom_same_zone_per_hour: Boredom increase while awake in the same zone.
_comments.boredom_per_entry: Boredom change after confirmed zone entry.
_comments.mood_per_nearby_car: Mood change for a car within the road-distance threshold.
_comments.car_mood_distance_km: Distance to road boundary for car mood effects.

periods._comment: Afternoon: prefer Plain and Waterhole; unspecified zones use low priors.
Evening: hunting bonus applies only when hunger exceeds daily threshold.
Night: Plain/Den without catch; Feeding spot after catch.

_comments.hunt_unavailable_prior: Maximum hunting-ground prior when an evening hunting bonus is unavailable.
_comments.road_penalty_per_car: Road logit penalty for each recent tourist car.
_comments.hunger_weight: Hunger contribution to Hunting ground score, only above threshold.
_comments.low_energy_weight: Low energy contribution to Den and Shade scores.
_comments.temperature_weight: Temperature contribution to Shade and Waterhole scores.
_comments.boredom_weight: Boredom contribution to Plain, Kopje, and Road scores.
_comments.periods: 24-hour exhaustive clock windows and logit priors; high=2, medium=1, low=0, none=-5.

_comments.smoothing_minutes: Trailing observed-GPS averaging window; excludes the left endpoint and includes the current fix.
_comments.window_minutes: Elapsed history for the rolling report-window path features.
_comments.grid_cell_km: Map-origin-aligned square cell width; covered area is occupied cells times cell area.
_comments.departure_margin_km: Observed departure must exceed this distance outside the last entered zone.
_comments.departure_confirmation_minutes: Require this many consecutive minute fixes beyond the departure margin before accepting a trip start.
_comments.detour_threshold_km: Observed chord-deviation threshold for detour diagnostics and missing/no/yes L4 cue.

_comments.boredom_goal_urgency: Urgency for Plain, Kopje and Road goals.
_comments.attraction_intercept: Trip attraction multiplier intercept; base is 1 - movement.heading_persistence.
_comments.attraction_urgency_weight: Trip attraction multiplier per unit urgency.
_comments.turn_intercept: Turning-noise multiplier before clipping; base is randomness.walk_heading_sd_degrees.
_comments.turn_boredom_weight: Increase in turning-noise multiplier per unit starting boredom.
_comments.turn_urgency_weight: Decrease in turning-noise multiplier per unit starting urgency.
_comments.turn_multiplier_range: Clipping range before adding the low-mood increment.
_comments.low_mood_threshold: Starting mood below this threshold adds the low-mood turn increment.
_comments.low_mood_turn_increment: Additive increment to the clipped turn multiplier on low-mood trips.
_comments.speed_intercept: Trip speed multiplier intercept; existing patrol speed bounds still apply.
_comments.speed_urgency_weight: Increase in trip speed multiplier per unit urgency.
_comments.detour_boredom_threshold: Only starting boredom above this value can trigger a detour.
_comments.detour_probability_scale: Per-trip probability = scale * (boredom - threshold) * (1 - urgency_weight * urgency), clipped to [0,1].
_comments.detour_urgency_weight: Suppression of discretionary detours by urgency; 0 preserves the original phase-three planner, 1 prevents detours at maximal urgency.
_comments.departure_alignment_weight: Fraction of urgency applied to face the first waypoint/goal at trip start; zero preserves inherited heading, without changing position.
_comments.detour_count_range: Inclusive uniform number of intermediate waypoints when a detour is selected.
_comments.detour_offset_km_range: Sideways waypoint distance from the trip-start to goal chord.
_comments.zone_exclusion_margin_km: Prefer waypoints outside unrelated zones plus this margin; source and goal zones are exempt.
_comments.waypoint_sampling_attempts: Bounded placement attempts per waypoint; try both sides before falling back to an in-map point.
_comments.waypoint_arrival_tolerance_km: Consume an intermediate waypoint within this radius; never teleport to it.

_comments.heading_persistence: Fraction of previous heading retained, between zero and one.
_comments.rest_jitter_sd_m: Per-axis resting true-position jitter in metres, constrained to its zone.
_comments.arrival_inset_km: Inset into destination after crossing boundary to support entry hysteresis.
_comments.patrol_energy_weight: Contribution of energy to position within the configured patrol speed range.
_comments.patrol_heat_weight: Contribution of heat discomfort to reduced patrol speed.
_comments.patrol_boredom_weight: Contribution of boredom to patrol speed.
_comments.patrol_speed_noise_sd: Minute speed variation as a fraction of the patrol speed range.
_comments.road_surface_speed_bonus_kmh: Speed bonus on the Road, still clipped to configured patrol-speed bounds.
_comments.patrol_cruise_fraction: Reserve this fraction of the configured patrol speed range for cruising; remaining variation still reflects energy, heat and boredom.

_comments.start: Start of tourist car Poisson process, inclusive.
_comments.end: End of tourist car window, exclusive.

_comments.prefer_parquet: Use parquet when pyarrow is installed; otherwise csv.gz.
_comments.json_pretty_max_days: Threshold for indented run metadata/statistics. Daily event JSON is always indented for readability.
_comments.embed_cumulative_path_in_reports: Include cumulative observed GPS arrays in reports when true; false keeps restored daily JSON compact.

_comments.size_px: Width and height of each square report image in pixels.
_comments.dpi: Raster DPI used to calculate figure size.
_comments.current_point_size: Current-position scatter-marker area in points squared.

images._comment: Text-free images: only zone shapes, accumulated observed GPS path and its endpoint. Every selected day is rendered unless --image-days or --no-images explicitly limits it.

_comments.hours_targets: Approximate behavioural reference values, warnings only; requested targets total 24.0 hours.
_comments.hours_ranges: Allowed run-mean hours before warning; resting includes sleeping and quiet rest.

road_response._comment: Synthetic causal response to a car already heard nearby. Changes continuous motion without requiring a road-zone entry; no future cars are inspected.

_comments.enabled: Enable car-triggered road curiosity and avoidance.
_comments.detection_distance_km: Maximum distance to nearest road point for hearing a car; a synthetic perception radius.
_comments.minimum_boredom: Minimum boredom for curiosity about a passing car.
_comments.minimum_energy: Minimum energy for investigating a passing car.
_comments.minimum_mood: Minimum mood for approaching the road rather than avoiding it.
_comments.approach_probability: Base probability of beginning a curiosity response when eligible.
_comments.avoidance_probability: Chance of retreating when a nearby car triggers low-mood or repeated-car avoidance.
_comments.avoidance_mood_threshold: Mood below this value can produce avoidance.
_comments.avoidance_car_count: Recent nearby car count triggering avoidance.
_comments.reaction_delay_minutes_range: Number of minute ticks after the car's containing minute before response begins; at least one tick ensures the response is strictly after the car.
_comments.approach_standoff_km: Target distance outside the road boundary, so investigation need not enter the Road zone.
_comments.arrival_tolerance_km: Distance from response target treated as arrival.
_comments.approach_max_minutes: Maximum time spent approaching before watching or resuming normal movement.
_comments.watch_minutes_range: Length of the stationary road-observation pause.
_comments.retreat_distance_km: Desired bounded displacement away from the road during avoidance.
_comments.retreat_max_minutes: Maximum duration of an avoidance retreat.
_comments.cooldown_minutes: Minimum delay after a completed response before another may start.
_comments.boredom_relief_per_watch_hour: Boredom reduction during a curiosity observation pause.
_comments.traffic_wait_enabled: Use a stationary delay for aversion; false retains a retreat waypoint while preserving the same destination.
_comments.traffic_delay_minutes_range: Uniform delay after an already-heard aversive car; resume the saved trip/activity afterward.

_comments.phase3: trip_* bounds apply to all committed trips except urgency/straightness (Hunting ground, Waterhole, Shade, Den). guardrail_* are hard limits, separate from unchanged phase-two calibration ranges; oracle ratio is checked in headline and all-report scopes.
_comments.zone_entry_share: Each named zone share of all entries; Road is exempt from minimum but zero warns.
_comments.hunt_attempt_day_fraction: Share of days with at least one chase.
_comments.catch_day_fraction: Share of days with at least one catch.
_comments.road_entry_day_fraction: Desired Road-entry day frequency; diagnostic, never forced.
_comments.unique_sequence_fraction_min: Strict lower bound on unique ordered daily entry sequences.
_comments.top_five_sequence_share_max: Strict upper bound for coverage of the five most common sequences.
_comments.mean_walking_speed_kmh: Mean measured patrol speed from true minute displacements.
_comments.hours_per_behaviour: Mean-hour diagnostic ranges; resting combines sleeping and quiet rest.
_comments.observed_true_path_ratio_max: Maximum pooled observed path length divided by true path length.
_comments.smoothed_rest_speed_max_kmh: Strict maximum pooled apparent speed of sleeping/quiet-rest intervals after five-minute smoothing.
_comments.abandoned_trip_mean_max: Maximum mean real journey abandonments per day; traffic delays are excluded.
_comments.traffic_abandonment_share_max: Maximum traffic_avoidance fraction of actual abandonments; zero if no abandonments.
_comments.waterhole_day_fraction: Fraction of days containing a confirmed Waterhole entry.
_comments.road_entry_share: Road entries as a fraction of all confirmed entries.
_comments.road_tourist_correlation_max: Maximum Pearson correlation between actual daily tourist count and daily road entry count.
_comments.road_evening_fraction_min: Minimum fraction of road entries with clock hour 19..23.
_comments.road_tourist_window_fraction_max: Maximum fraction of road entries during the configured tourist window.
_comments.events_per_day: Mean daily count across the unchanged 17-token vocabulary.
_comments.non_feast_late_entry_fraction_min: Minimum non-feast-day fraction with a confirmed zone entry strictly after 23:00.
_comments.feast_post_meal_entry_fraction_max: Maximum feast-day fraction with a zone entry after EAT_END.
_comments.prey_kopje_dwell_correlation_min: Minimum Pearson correlation of prey density with first Kopje-to-next-entry time gap, where observable.
_comments.prey_first_chase_correlation_max: Maximum Pearson correlation of prey density with first chase time on hunting days.
_comments.hunger_wake_correlation_max: Maximum Pearson correlation of start hunger with wake time.
_comments.heat_shade_entry_correlation_max: Maximum Pearson correlation of daily heat with shade entry time.
_comments.headline_l3_improvement_min: Minimum relative improvement of mean cross-validated headline L3 over headline L2.
_comments.oracle_l0_ratio_range: Oracle/L0 loss range, checked separately for headline and all reports on identical CV days.
_comments.oracle_l2_improvement_min: Minimum relative oracle improvement over L2 in both headline and all-report comparisons.
_comments.headline_l4_improvement_min: Minimum relative headline CV improvement of L4 over L3.

_comments.coverage_grid_km: Square map-coverage grid cell width in kilometres.
_comments.rest_smoothing_minutes: Trailing mean-position smoothing width; only complete all-resting windows contribute apparent speeds.

_comments.goal_commitment: Keep destinations until arrival unless a recorded safety or schedule interrupt occurs.
_comments.fatigue_interrupt_threshold: Interrupt travel when energy falls below this threshold.
_comments.fatigue_recovery_threshold: Rearm fatigue interruption only after this energy recovery threshold.
_comments.heat_interrupt_threshold: Interrupt travel when temperature exceeds this threshold.
_comments.heat_recovery_threshold: Rearm heat interruption after temperature falls below this threshold.
_comments.heat_reference: Reference daily heat latent for timing and drinking effects.
_comments.shade_entry_heat_shift_minutes: Minutes earlier shade departure per unit above reference heat.
_comments.shade_entry_jitter_sd_minutes: Gaussian noise on heat-driven shade departure time.
_comments.shade_departure_window: Allowed clock window for starting the committed shade journey.
_comments.shade_wake_heat_shift_minutes: Minutes later midday wake per unit above reference heat.
_comments.shade_wake_jitter_sd_minutes: Gaussian noise on heat-driven midday wake time.
_comments.drink_heat_multiplier: Fractional change of drink duration per unit heat above reference.
_comments.evening_staging_time: Start positioning for an evening trip; hunger eligibility is fixed for the day.
_comments.hunt_arrival_deadline: Desired latest initial hunting-ground arrival for hungry days.
_comments.first_chase_wait_max_minutes: Maximum initial eligible stalking wait before the first chase attempt.
_comments.first_chase_wait_min_minutes: Minimum initial stalking wait before a first chase attempt.
_comments.road_goal_traffic_penalty: Road-goal penalty associated with traffic volume.
_comments.road_entry_probability: Base chance an eligible low-traffic curiosity approach enters the road.
_comments.road_entry_traffic_decay: Decay of road-entry probability as traffic volume increases.
_comments.road_entry_inset_km: Distance inside the road boundary for an entry destination.
_comments.night_nap_max_cycles: Maximum catnap cycles begun in one night.
_comments.interrupted_rest_minutes: Recovery rest following a safety interruption.
_comments.afternoon_water_probability: Probability of a committed afternoon water visit when no road visit was selected; improves observable heat/drinking and prevents staging turnbacks.
_comments.evening_road_probability: Maximum one-off evening road choice chance, multiplied by boredom and an observed-traffic discount.
_comments.road_volume_reference_count: Observed cars per day up to this count carry no extra evening road penalty.
_comments.road_volume_decay: Exponential road-goal penalty per observed car above the reference count.
_comments.road_daytime_multiplier: Relative road goal/entry odds outside the post-tourist evening window.
_comments.road_evening_start: Earliest favored evening road choice; must also be after tourist end.
_comments.road_evening_end: Latest favored evening road-goal decision, exclusive; travel may finish later.
_comments.night_patrol_entry_weights: Probabilities of planning 1, 2 or 3 night destinations on non-catch days; actual incidental crossings are also measured.
_comments.night_patrol_distance_penalty: Per-km logit penalty for long night legs, favoring nearby territory.
_comments.night_repeat_zone_weight: Relative weight for a previously visited night destination.
_comments.daytime_travel_budget_minutes: After this much pre-night walking, finish current trips but decline new voluntary daytime wandering; water, shade and hunt schedules still apply.
_comments.water_trip_grace_minutes: Maximum hunt-start grace for completing an already committed water journey; hunt cutoff remains unchanged.
_comments.morning_scout_probability: Probability of a morning scouting trip to Kopje after initial grooming.
_comments.scout_base_minutes: Minimum mean Kopje scouting dwell before heading toward Plain.
_comments.scout_prey_extra_minutes: Additional scouting dwell from low to high prey signal; observable in the next entry gap.
_comments.scout_jitter_sd_minutes: Independent noise in scouting dwell; scheduled heat departures may interrupt scouting.
_comments.prey_reference_range: Fixed normalization for prey-linked dwell and hunt timing; separate from latent sampling bounds.
_comments.hunger_wake_shift_minutes: Maximum earlier waking shift at hunger=1; original 05:00–07:00 clip is preserved.
_comments.prey_hunt_delay_max_minutes: Maximum departure delay beyond hunt start at low prey; high prey has no added delay.
_comments.night_pause_minutes_range: Total stop between night legs; safe-zone short catnaps use the original duration range, followed by quiet rest for the remainder.

_comments.groom_mean_minutes: Arithmetic mean of each lognormal grooming session.
_comments.groom_lognormal_sigma: Log-space standard deviation of grooming duration.
_comments.rest_minutes_range: Uniform daytime stationary resting duration at a destination.
_comments.visit_minutes_range: Uniform patrol/stalk destination dwell duration where applicable.
_comments.midday_wake_mean: Normal scheduled end of midday sleep.
_comments.midday_wake_sd_minutes: Variation in scheduled midday wake time.
_comments.cool_wake_after: Earliest clock time for temperature-triggered waking.
_comments.cool_wake_temperature: Temperature below which midday sleep can end after cool_wake_after.
_comments.hunt_end: Clock cutoff for stalking and new chases.
_comments.prey_encounters_per_hour: Base Poisson encounter rate multiplied by daily prey density.
_comments.fail_rest_minutes_range: Uniform rest duration after a failed chase.
_comments.eat_max_minutes: Maximum eating duration after a catch.
_comments.night_walk_minutes_range: Uniform night walking duration between naps.
_comments.night_start: Clock time at which no-catch night behaviour begins.

_comments.duration_seconds_range: Uniform chase duration, fitting start and outcome inside one minute.
_comments.outcome_delay_seconds_range: Allowed delay between CHASE_START and CATCH/FAIL; duration must lie inside this range.
_comments.factor_min: Catch-factor value when energy and mood are zero.
_comments.factor_max: Catch-factor value when energy and mood are one.
_comments.energy_weight: Energy weight in catch factor, normalized with mood weight.
_comments.mood_weight: Mood weight in catch factor, normalized with energy weight.
_comments.probability_clip: Lower and upper bound on final catch probability.

_comments.hunt_threshold: Daily uniform minimum hunger for stalking.

_comments.behaviour: Committed goals, physiological interrupts, heat/traffic effects and bounded night naps.
_comments.activity: Activity timing and durations, including the hunt cutoff and catnap range.
_comments.chase: Chase mechanics and energy/mood-dependent catch probabilities.
_comments.latent_ranges: Uniform per-day hidden-state ranges, sampled once at initialization.
_comments.softmax_temperature: Higher values spread goal probabilities more evenly.
_comments.chase_base_probability: Base catch probability, adjusted by energy and mood.
_comments.oracle_days: Default number of independent original days in oracle mode; CLI --oracle-days takes precedence.
_comments.oracle_rollouts: Default independent continuation samples per usable report; CLI --oracle-rollouts takes precedence.
_comments.oracle_near_zero_nats: Oracle loss at or below this absolute threshold is near zero; report the finite-rollout smoothing floor alongside it.
_comments.oracle_noise_relative_tolerance: Absolute oracle-to-L0 gap divided by L0 at or below this threshold is close to L0; compare identical held-out days.
_comments.laplace_alpha: Positive additive count smoothing for all nine classes.
_comments.train_fraction: Legacy setting retained for old configs; unused by day-fold cross-validation.
_comments.l3_min_cell_count: Legacy setting retained for old configs; replaced by l3_interpolation_k.
_comments.mostly_noise_relative_tolerance: L0/L1/L2 loss spread divided by L0 below this threshold means mostly noise.
_comments.near_deterministic_ratio: L2/L0 below this threshold means nearly deterministic.
_comments.cv_folds: Deterministic interleaved folds of whole days; use fewer folds only when fewer days exist.
_comments.headline_reports: Report indices contributing to headline losses; all usable reports are also evaluated.
_comments.l3_interpolation_k: Positive L2 prior pseudo-count in (cell class count + k*p_L2)/(cell total + k).
_comments.shade_hour_cut: Three shade-history bins: not_yet, observed before this hour, observed at/after this hour.
_comments.l4_binning: fixed uses historical missing/low/high cues; training_tertiles fits three numeric bins per report on training days only, with separate missingness; detour remains missing/no/yes.
_comments.l4_interpolation_k: L3 prior pseudo-count for path-cue cells; fixed before evaluation.
_comments.l4_straightness_cut: Three bins: missing, below this fixed observed straightness, at/above it.
_comments.l4_speed_cut_kmh: Three bins: missing, below this fixed recent-window speed, at/above it.
